entries.final_answer: Back up, then proceed: when init re-runs on a populated .kittify/ that is missing config.yaml, move existing operator-authored content (custom missions, memory notes) into a timestamped .kittify/.backup-<UTC-timestamp>/ before copying scaffold, and report the backup path to the user. Never rmtree operator-owned content.
entries.question: When spec-kitty init finds user-authored .kittify/missions or memory but no config.yaml, what should it do?
